title: Tools: More macos-setup.sh cleanup
description:
Use command substitution instead of backticks. Use an array for our
build-time make options. Fixup some dynamically sudo-ized commands.

[skip ci]

commits_data.title: Tools: More macos-setup.sh cleanup
commits_data.message:
Tools: More macos-setup.sh cleanup

Use command substitution instead of backticks. Use an array for our
build-time make options. Fixup some dynamically sudo-ized commands.

[skip ci]
